tickets.title: Register the frontier-imp role (Astra xhigh); repair jobs go to it
tickets.what: D-2026-11-27-06 as revised by the owner: a dedicated role `frontier-imp` handles escalated repairs; imp's placement and frontend-imp are unchanged. (1) Register `frontier-imp` as a first-class implementer role: shipped default role file (implementer instructions, can_continue, one pi place `openai/gpt-6.2-astra` thinking `xhigh`), accepted everywhere `imp` is (hud_create role, ticket `role` enum, roster, role caps, worktree isolation, hud_land, panel/Control listing). The owner's ~/.hud/roles/frontier-imp.json already exists with that content; roster must list it. (2) A repair job goes to frontier-imp instead of imp placement: (a) a ticket dispatch whose ticket has a non-empty `repairs` list and role imp (ticket queue, unattended runs, main's hud_create with `ticket`); (b) a `hud_send` repair of an imp job that starts a new job because the source closed outside the resume window (`continued_as`). Unchanged: land-gate check repairs and native-session resumes keep the source worker; explicit `retry_of` keeps its role/preset; frontend-imp tickets stay frontend-imp. If frontier-imp is unavailable (quota, trust, cap), fall back to imp placement and record why. Record `route.source: "repair-route"` on the job. Update docs/reference.md (roles list, placement section, the land-repair line).

acceptance.text: Test: hud_roster lists frontier-imp; hud_create role frontier-imp with worktree isolation runs on pi astra xhigh
Test: an imp repair ticket under even placement dispatches as frontier-imp with route source repair-route; a frontend-imp repair ticket stays frontend-imp
Test: hud_send repair after close starts a frontier-imp job; within the resume window the source session resumes
Test: land-gate repair and retry_of keep the source; frontier-imp unavailable falls back to imp with a recorded reason
Shipped role file and reference.md updated
